import json
r=[x for x in json.load(open('data/ucsc_ncbiRefSeqCurated_shh.json'))['ncbiRefSeqCurated'] if x['name']=='NM_000193.4'][0]
exs=list(map(int,r['exonStarts'].rstrip(',').split(',')))
exe=list(map(int,r['exonEnds'].rstrip(',').split(',')))
# transcript exon 1 on minus strand is last genomic exon
ex1=(exs[-1],exe[-1])
cds=(r['cdsStart'],r['cdsEnd'])
inter=(max(ex1[0],cds[0]),min(ex1[1],cds[1]))
print(r['chrom'], r['strand'], r['name'], 'exon1_0based', ex1, 'cds_intersection_0based', inter, '1based', f\"{r['chrom']}:{inter[0]+1}-{inter[1]}\")
